claims.statement: Gulf oil flows excluding Iran recovered to 81% of pre-war levels in September, with crude and condensate at 91% but refined products at only 60%.
The main energy constraint remains downstream in refined products even as Gulf crude flows recover.
The G7 emergency stock release is easing immediate market supply concern alongside stronger Middle Eastern exports.
The European Commission president announced one additional year of flexibility for methane exporters, but a formal legal timetable change was not established by the evidence reviewed.
